status: Secondary derived diagnostic, specified after orthogonal-study aggregates and before computing this null; no new training or inputs.
records: All new and historical frames; feature-axis, absent-pair, ++ primary slice; both fixed pairs and both natural/separable maps; no fit-based selection.
null: For each background separately: R_null(a,b)=sqrt(R(a,0)^2+R(0,b)^2). Then take the median across the same four backgrounds and apply exactly the same fitter/threshold fractions.
matching: Exactly matches the full measured single-axis response norms at the tested background. No encoder knowledge, target labels, training, or fit parameters are supplied.
expected_identity: For the coordinate-separable map, orthogonal output coordinates make this equality exact to numerical precision. Verify raw saved grids satisfy it.
limits: Assumes orthogonal output effects. A discrepancy may reflect output-vector angles or nonlinear interaction, and is not by itself evidence for correction. Compare tilted-quadratic residuals as well. Passing this null does not mean the feature directions are unprivileged; it explains that privileging through one-dimensional nonlinear sensitivity.
